review.tagline: Code for the book on building a GPT-style LLM in PyTorch
review.summary: Official code for the Manning book "Build a Large Language Model (From Scratch)". Notebooks and scripts implement tokenization, attention, a GPT model, pretraining, classification finetuning, instruction finetuning and LoRA in plain PyTorch, without external LLM libraries. Bonus folders add from-scratch Llama 3.2, Qwen3, Gemma 3, Olmo 3, KV cache, MoE and DPO.
review.audience: Python developers learning how LLMs work by coding one in PyTorch
strengths: Main chapter code runs on a conventional laptop and uses a GPU automatically if present
Plain PyTorch with no external LLM libraries, so every component is readable
Bonus material covers KV cache, GQA, MoE, DPO and several model architectures
Exercise solutions, a companion video course and CI tests on Linux, Windows and macOS
weaknesses: Tied to a print book; contributions extending main chapter code are not accepted
Produces a small educational model, not a production-grade LLM
License is reported as NOASSERTION; the README states no license terms
Video course and quiz PDF are hosted by the publisher, not in the repo
needs: Needs PyTorch, Jupyter, Ollama (optional, ch07 evaluation)
Models: GPT-2, Llama 3.2, Qwen3, Gemma 3, Olmo 3
